thread:
liz: Hey team, quick sync — we're rolling out the new routing policy telemetry and need to align on labels/names for dashboards. Goal: runtime + infra inputs so product can show per-policy SLA/cost. Thoughts?

raj: +1. main ask from infra: keep cardinality low (no api_key/user_id). we should enumerate required labels.

maria: Agreed. Proposal: use labels: model, model_variant, deployment(env), region, route_policy, customer_tier. Avoid freeform fields.

tom: For Prom metrics, prefer histograms (`request_duration_seconds`) with buckets. Also add `request_count` counter. Exemplar support would be great for tracing.

liz: Good. Also product wants a `policy_fallback` dimension to see how often a route falls back to cheaper model. but that might be binary high-card. maybe keep it as `fallback_taken=true/false`.

raj: `fallback_taken` boolean as a label is fine if the cardinality is 2. just watch combinations with `route_policy` + `model_variant`.

henry: Can we standardize naming prefixes? e.g., `redwood_inference_` for Prom, and OTEL metric names mirror that. avoids mixing with infra metrics.

maria: +1 on prefix. Also follow Otel semantic conventions where possible. For model metadata, prefer `model.name` and `model.version` in OTEL resource attributes instead of labels. But Prom needs labels — decide mapping.

raj: Mapping idea: OTEL resource/model.name -> prometheus label `model`, resource/model.version -> `model_version` (but truncate commit hashes to 12 chars). high-card risk: use `model_version` only for major/minor where possible.

liz: Product also asked for per-route token-cost estimates. Suggest `tokens_requested` gauge? or just derive from traces?

tom: I'd add `tokens_requested` as a histogram (small buckets) but that's another high-card metric. maybe aggregate at the ingress level and keep per-route only.

maria: Quick schema draft (Prom labels): `model`, `model_variant`, `deployment`, `region`, `route_policy`, `customer_tier`, `fallback_taken`. Keep `request_id` out of labels; put it as exemplar/trace id.

liz: can eng-runtime add exemplars? that'll help link to traces for flakey requests.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-04-03T15:42Z: branch `metrics/route-labels` deployed to staging.

henry: I'll follow up with a cardinality runbook example: show top-10 unique label combos per minute and alert if cardinality growth > x. Also suggest scrubber for `model_variant` to map many hashes to canonical versions.

raj: Action items: (1) eng-ml provide canonical model list + allowed `model_version` values (maria) (2) eng-runtime instrument histograms/counters + exemplars (tom/henry) (3) observability to create dashboard templates (liz/product) (4) infra to add retention/cost estimates for new labels (raj).

liz: timeline? want staging dashboards next week so product can review.

maria: I'll post the canonical list by EOD today. starting with models: `redwood-small`, `redwood-base`, `redwood-qa-ft`, and map variants to `v1`, `v2` etc.

tom: I'll spike adding exemplars + histogram buckets in staging later today.

liz: Thanks. keep this thread updated, please ping if anyone hits high-card warnings. :thumbsup:
